provenance_note: The isolated gateway served this repository's own copy of the app: capture.py's setup installed it from this checkout (POST /api/apps/install), trusted it and enabled it, and every picture shows its committed bundle (ui/dist/index.mjs) and backend. Kiro Crew still ships a built-in design-critique and refuses a second install under the same name, so the Kiro Crew tree the capture ran on is that release's App Kit level-1 commit with only the built-in copy removed (src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins/design_critique and its BUILTIN_NAMES row); kirocrew_tree_dirty records that.
data_notes: The screens the critic reads are fictional mockups of a made-up library app (Fernleaf Library), written for this README as HTML and rendered to PNG (capture/fixtures/). Every name, card number and the .example email address in them is invented.
They are handed to the page's own file picker, exactly as choosing them in the browser would; the page uploads them through the dashboard's upload endpoint.
Every critique and the follow-up answer came from a live model, so the wording, the findings and their count differ from run to run.
